ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution consists of approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels on lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central region and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black patch concentrated around the median notch extending roughly 40% horizontally; left lobe displays isolated dark punctate spots on a white field; right lobe features a large dark contiguous patch at the distal tip and a smaller dark intrusion from the center-right trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees and a vertical depth relative to lobe height of approximately 18%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; right lobe distal edge displays higher-amplitude, irregular jaggedness compared to the more uniform serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve characterized by distal convexity at the tips transitioning to a distinct concave trajectory as the edge approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters on the mid-left lobe ventral surface; dense aggregation of dark pixel clusters on the right lobe tip corresponding to localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark, unaligned linear markings detected on the white field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged, irregular notches on the trailing margin of the right lobe distal tip; multiple punctate dark marks across the white ventral surfaces of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'winged' border where the central black pigmentation meets the white lateral regions, forming a symmetrical tapered transition.
